limits: Accepted questions identify the judgments endorsed; exact replay also retains other raw fields without endorsing their meaning.
No application routing or impact gate is implemented by the host APIs; consumers must apply an explicit policy.
The provisional 0.80 evidence threshold deferred four clear cases. It remains unchanged; these diagnostic range misses are preserved, not converted into automatic passes.
Probabilities are plausible judgments, not independently verified calibration. Live calls used different correlation IDs.
Replay proves fidelity with recorded responses, not current provider quality. Historical token usage is replayed as integration data; paid replay calls are zero.
